title: Craftabilities
description: A mod adding recipes for uncraftable items, while also including blasting recipes and smelting recipes to items.
body:
**Adds Crafting Recipes for the following:**
- Iron Horse Armor
- Diamond Horse Armor
- Gold Horse Armor
- Chainmail Armor
- Saddle
- NameTag

  
**Adds Smelting Recipe for Rotten flesh to leather**

**Adds Blasting Recipes For the Following:**


- Cobblestone
- Clay
- Netherrack
- Sand
- Sandstone
- Red Sandstone
